{{Quote|Thank you. You may proceed. We will take custody of the Jedi.|The Senate Guard, to Bail Organa|<ref name="Rots" />}}
An '''individual''' worked as a [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] and was stationed at a door to the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during an [[Declaration of a New Order|emergency session]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The guard encountered [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and his two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] companions, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and was excited at the opportunity to [[Prisoner/Legends|arrest]] them. However, Kenobi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] the Senate Guard, convincing him that they could leave the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] freely.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Welcome back, Senator. May I see your clearance?|The Senate Guard, to Bail Organa|<ref name="Rots" />}}
[[File:Galacticsenate.png|thumb|right|300px|The Senate Guard was stationed at an entrance to the Grand Convocation Chamber in 19 BBY.]]
A [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Rots" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]], including the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard's]] appearance, to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the guard was stationed with a partner at a door to the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during an emergency session of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], in which the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The guard blinked and adjusted the drape of his [[Robe/Legends|robe]] when [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] exited a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] with his [[Senatorial aide|aides]] and two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. The guard quickly looked at his partner and was in disbelief at his good fortune, as the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had recently been outlawed, and he expected promotions would be handed out if he [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]] the two Jedi.<ref name="Rots" />

The guard avoided staring at the Jedi and attempted to act professionally as he received Organa's [[Identichip/Legends|identichip]]. He was pleased with his own businesslike demeanor as he returned it to the senator. The guard stated that he and his partner would take custody of the Jedi, prompting Kenobi to [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] the guards through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Kenobi suggested that he and Yoda should stay with Organa, and the guard agreed that it was a good idea as Kenobi seemed like a reasonable person.<ref name="Rots" />

[[File:Obi-Wan_Yoda_and_Bail.png|thumb|left|300px|The Senate Guard encountered (from left to right) Yoda, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Bail Organa and was mind tricked by Kenobi.]]
The guard rationalized that the Grand Convocation Chamber was secure enough to prevent the Jedi from causing trouble, and that they could be arrested upon their exit. He did not want to be perceived as unreasonable and found himself constantly nodding and agreeing with Kenobi's suggestions. The Senate Guard continued believing that the Jedi's plan was acceptable and did not think to object when they changed course and [[Infiltration of the Jedi Temple/Legends|departed]] for the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] while Organa entered the chamber.<ref name="Rots" />

==Personality and traits==
The guard was excited upon seeing the Jedi, believing that he would receive a promotion for their capture. He exercised self-control to appear professional while verifying Organa's identity and was happy with the way he presented himself. The guard was prepared to take custody of the Jedi with his partner, but when he was mind tricked by Kenobi, he believed that the senator and the Jedi could enter the Grand Convocation Chamber without disruption, and agreed with their suggestions so that he could appear reasonable like them. The guard was weak-minded enough to be susceptible to Kenobi's mind trick, which allowed the Jedi to leave freely without the guard realizing his error.<ref name="Rots" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Senate Guard appeared in [[Matthew Stover]]'s [[2005]] [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Rots" />
